QuestInfo.name: Nothing Lasts Forever
QuestInfo.0:
You've learned the demon's name, but that alone doesn't defeat him.
See what Ryan has to say.
QuestInfo.1:
You've learned the demon's name, but that alone doesn't defeat him.
Keep going.
QuestInfo.2:
The halo in the sky is evidence of a gap in space and time.
The curse has separated the palace from the outside world.
It may end if someone from the outside steps in, or if the demon's powers simply exhaust themselves.
